title: MCPL v0 action (proposed extension: drive)
description: Something an AI agent can do on a screen, through that screen, while the operator watches. Listed in a component's component.json "actions" and served as an MCP tool. The screen carries it out with the same code its own controls use, so its event and lesson progress are exactly what a person doing it would produce.

name.description: The MCP tool name: <area>.<object>[.<verb>], unique in the app.

title.description: Shown to the operator in the agent bar, and to the model as the tool title.

description.description: What the action does and what it never does, for the model.

route.description: The page the operator is taken to before the action runs, so they see it happen. Must be one of the component's routes.

input.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of the arguments, served as the tool's inputSchema.

writes.description: True when the action changes anything. The operator then sees what it will do and must allow it first.

destructive.description: True when the change destroys or replaces something (MCP destructiveHint).

secret.description: Argument names that hold a key or password: masked wherever they are shown, never logged.

emits.description: The app event the screen emits when the action succeeds. Must be in the component's emits.
